about_the_game:
The final product for a team of high school seniors as a part of their game design class, Garden Masters is a free-to-play, fast-paced, first-person gardening game where you aim to make the most money by planting seeds to grow your plant empire.

In Garden Masters, there are three unique areas where you can aim to expand your garden. The humble and rustic Breezyglade, the arid and desolate Barrenbloom, and the vividly tropical Sandyshrub. Each area has its own unique environmental hazards, such as animals, insects, crabs, scorpions, and... Sharks?!

To amass your garden empire, you must do the following:

  • Buy seeds!

  • Grow Plants!

  • Avoid hazards and fight off pests!

  • Earn Money!

So, how much money can you earn?
